concept.title: Our Commitment
concept.body: Our fresh pasta is made in-house daily for a wonderfully chewy texture. The pizza dough is our proprietary blend — crispy on the outside, fluffy inside. We use premium Italian ripened tomatoes to bring out the best flavors.

fritta.title: New Experience! Fried Pizza Fritta
fritta.body: A brand-new crispy fried pizza experience. Great for takeout and eating on the go. Four flavors: Ume Chicken, Teriyaki Egg, Potato Mentaiko & Apple (new!).
